concerns.text: The plan introduces a new functional requirement FR-008 (not defined in the specification) but no task in tasks.md is tagged or described to satisfy this requirement.
The implementation plan references a manual "Phase 4 – Physical testbed execution" that is not represented by any task in tasks.md, leaving this plan element without concrete work.

SC-006 (variable‑fit verification) is described in the plan, yet there is no dedicated task (e.g., T017) that implements the Variable‑Fit Verification step; existing tasks T011/T012 only mention validation status but do not constitute a full verification task.
